penalties.details: The Company has received a Demand Notice under Section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 for assessment year 2020-21. The demand, amounting to Rs. 46,90,26,230/- (inclusive of interest), pertains to the alleged non-withholding or short-withholding of TDS on the asset-purchase consideration.
penalties.impact: Based on assessment of facts and prevailing legal position, the Company believes that it has adequate legal and factual grounds to contest the same and is taking necessary steps to protect its interest. Pursuant to the terms of the Share/Asset Purchase Agreement (SPA), any liability arising on account of future claims by the Income Tax Department relating to withholding tax on the purchase consideration is contractually borne by the Seller. Accordingly, the Company does not expect any material financial or operational impact.

penalties.authority: ADIT (INT TAXN)-2, HYD of the Income Tax Department
penalties.details: The Company has received a Demand Notice under Section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 for assessment year 2020-21. The demand, amounting to Rs. 46,90,26,230/- (inclusive of interest), pertains to the alleged non-withholding or short-withholding of TDS on the share/asset-purchase consideration. During Q2 of FY 2026-27, the Company, made a pre-deposit of 20% of the disputed tax demand amounting to ₹8,89,75,193 on 04 July 2026 with the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) / Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) in connection with the appeal proceedings. The said amount has been fully indemnified by the seller in accordance with the indemnity provisions relating to the appeal filed in Q1 of FY 2026-27.
penalties.impact: Based on the assessment of facts and the prevailing legal position, the Company believes that it has adequate legal and factual grounds to contest the matter and is taking all necessary steps to protect its interests. During Q2 of FY 2026-27, the Company made a pre-deposit of 20% of the disputed tax demand amounting to ₹8,89,75,193 in connection with the pending appeal proceedings. Pursuant to the terms of the Share/Asset Purchase Agreement (SPA), any liability arising from claims by the Income Tax Department relating to withholding tax on the purchase consideration, including the aforesaid pre-deposit amount, is contractually borne by Blackstone (the Seller). The pre-deposit has been fully indemnified by the Seller and, accordingly, the Company does not expect any material financial or operational impact arising from this matter.

operating_notes.text: The Group operates in a single segment as a CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) provider.

DSO was 79 days in Q1FY27 against 76 days in Q4FY26.
